summary: UTV driver lost control and fell 250 ft down a steep, loose embankment just outside Hot Sulphur Springs; Grand County SAR executed a ~5-hour nighttime technical rope rescue with drone overhead lighting, then handed the patient to Grand County EMS / Med Evac; name and condition not released.
notes: Call came in 11:30 p.m.; patient stabilized and out of field by 4 a.m.
